description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Dark], [Awoken Dark], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dark +30% Boost (15s)] and [Absorb Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Dark
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Absorb Mode
description.text: Grants 250 SB points after using three Dark attacks, casts Abyssal Sword when removed

description.name: Abyssal Sword
description.text: One single attack (4.60) capped at 99999, multiplier increased by 0.0016 for every SB point, 100% hit rate
